title: fix(studio): the condition builder writes the validator's per-site list membership
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvjXfskAqB3a1vHN3s

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoQ5BUu4zUPS25AFu9nz32Rj)_

Fixes #36381

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 里用条件构建器给多值字段（标签、多选等）写「包含」条件时，按钮可见/禁用条件和 previous 上的条件改为带存在性检查的写法，校验器建议的写法与构建器写出的从此是同一句；流程起始条件的写法不变。
- 为什么做：条件构建器与表达式校验器各写各的，构建器写出的条件在按钮的稀疏数据行和新建时为空的 previous 上会直接报错（承接多值字段条件那张卡的后续）。
- 出错会怎样：作者用构建器写出的条件在运行时报错或被校验器要求改写；已按旧写法存下的这类条件会以原始表达式打开，不再显示成行，内容不变；本改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`@objectstack/formula` gets one published list-membership prescription, and both Studio writers call it instead of restating it.

- `listMembershipSource(read, member, contains, filterCompiled?)` (new export, with its `ListSubjectRead` type): the membership test for one site, unparenthesised. `has()`-guarded for a `record.` / `previous.` read, `!= null`-guarded for a bare name at a flattened site, `.contains(…)` where the source compiles to a query filter. The private `listMembershipRewrite` (the `list-equality` refusal's `rewrite`) is now that text in parentheses — same bytes as before, pinned below.
- `cel-list-membership.ts` (`ui/packages/app-shell`): `listMembershipCel` calls `listMembershipSource`, choosing the site from the subject (a subject with a root is a `ROOT.FIELD` read; one without is a bare name). `readListMembership` reads back all four written shapes and still accepts only text the writer reproduces byte for byte.
- `flow-edge-condition-rows.ts`: its read-back of membership goes through `readListMembership` instead of two hand-written patterns, so a flow edge's `record.` membership row (now `has()`-guarded) still reopens as a row.
- Card to-do 2: the `checkListEquality` docblock no longer names `S != null && V in S` as the prescription; it points at `listMembershipSource` and names the three spellings.

Which of the card's three sites changed text: the action row (`record.`) and `previous` (both had faulted on the measured rows below). The record-triggered start condition writes bare names and its text is unchanged; its pins move with the others so all three sites are held the same way.

## Tests

- New top-level `describe` in `ConditionBuilder.listSubject-36167.test.tsx` (the builder's existing harness file), one row per site — action row (`record.labels`), `previous.labels`, record-triggered start condition (bare `labels`, `fieldPrefix: ''`, flattened scope with `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'`):
  - the condition built by clicking through the builder equals the validator's own `list-equality` rewrite for that site (modulo the literal's quote style and the outer parentheses), for contains and does-not-contain;
  - `validateExpression` returns no error for the built text, and `readListMembership` reads it back;
  - `celEngine` evaluates it with no fault on the sparse row (`labels` absent), on `previous: null`, and on a null list at the flow site, plus the member / non-member answers;
  - a stored built condition, alone and joined, reopens as rows at its site;
  - an instrument control showing the old unguarded text faults on the same rows.
- `validate-list-equality-36167.test.ts` (formula): a new `describe` pins `rewrite === "(" + listMembershipSource(…) + ")"` at all four sites, both operators.
- Existing pins updated to the guarded spelling for `record.` subjects: `ConditionBuilder.listSubject-36167`, `ConditionBuilder.typedEmptyOps-11894`, `ObjectValidationsPanel.typedEmptyOps-11894`, `FlowEdgeInspector.multiValue-35992`, `flow-edge-condition-rows.multiValue-35992`. The raw-editor list gains the old unguarded `record.` text.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- Premise, measured on `@objectstack/formula` dist at base `c826e8a1`: `record.tags != null && "a" in record.tags` on `{ record: {} }` answers `runtime: No such key: tags`; `previous.tags != null && …` on `previous: null` the same; the `has()` forms answer `false` / `true` without a fault.
- Ablation (one leg, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation `bare: !subject.includes('.')` → `bare: true`, i.e. the old spelling for every subject, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): the new describe went 4 failed / 6 passed — the `record.` and `previous.` rows red on both the prescription and the engine assertions, the bare-name row green, as expected for the site whose text did not change.
- Runs at HEAD: see Verification.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A `record.` / `previous.` membership the builder stored in the old unguarded spelling (written between the earlier list-subject change and this one) now opens in the raw CEL editor, unchanged, instead of as a row. Accepting the old text as a row would be a second dialect in the reader; rebuilding the row writes the guarded form.
- A sharing rule's `condition` is a `filterCompiled` site, where the validator prescribes `.contains(…)`. The builder does not know a mount is filter-compiled (no host passes it), so a membership built there would still be written with `in`. `listMembershipSource` takes the flag, so a host that knows can pass it; not measured whether the generic sharing-rule form offers list subjects today. Filed as #37847, which opens with that measurement.
